records.subject: You're in -- let's get Harbor Ventures set up
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone (stall_reasons). Starter, single admin, 8 days left: modest unaided odds.

draft.subject: Getting Harbor Ventures' first project started
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks again for the welcome call last week. Since then I haven't seen a first project in the account, so I wanted to check in before things get busy.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them 
inside your first project is where everything else starts. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to follow it.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project alongside you and answer anything that came up after our call.

Best,
Priya
